content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm looking for guidance on how to use terminals x and memento. Are there any example applications available? Thanks for your support.

Hi, You can find examples here: [url]. The X (open connector) can be used to control outputs such as a textblock. The Memento (flag) is useful for storing states or performing recursions, for example resetting a counter with its own output. Regards, [user_name]
